pirs.title: Lagrådet yttrande on prop. 2025/26:246 (criminal responsibility age cut)
pirs.description: Lagrådet review of HD03246 (prop. 2025/26:246) pending. CRC Art. 40(3)(a) compliance is the key legal question. V (HD024142), C (HD024146), MP (HD024148) have all invoked CRC as grounds for rejection. If Lagrådet flags incompatibility, probability of government retreat increases from ~15% to ~30-40%.

pirs.title: EU Habitats Directive and NRL compliance risk from forestry deregulation
pirs.description: Sweden's prop. 2025/26:242 (HD03242) reduces samrådsplikten and avverkningsanmälan obligations. Combined with prior deregulation since 2022, EU Habitats Directive Art. 6 and NRL Reg. 2024/1991 compliance is at risk. V (HD024141) and MP (HD024147) have provided detailed legal analysis. Naturvårdsverket compliance opinion pending.

pirs.title: Centerpartiet position consolidation on JuU criminal age cut
pirs.description: C's HD024146 opposes criminal responsibility age cut on CRC grounds. C is the pivotal actor — if C intensifies opposition and S joins, the government majority narrows to 165 vs 163 (or fails if L wavers). Monitor C riksdag group statement after Lagrådet yttrande on HD03246.

pirs.title: S decision on whether to join CRC opposition coalition on HD03246
pirs.description: S (94 seats) has not yet declared a position on the criminal responsibility age cut. If S joins V+C+MP (forming 163-seat coalition), government's 165-seat majority becomes razor-thin. S decision is likely driven by (a) Lagrådet outcome, (b) Barnombudsmannen statement, (c) polling on crime vs rights.
